opening.argument: The video presents Averius as a way to mine Litecoin and earn cryptocurrency, then directs viewers toward registration and depositing funds. It claims that deposits can produce two or three percent in daily profit, while displaying mining and daily-profit figures. The visible registration process and the site's separate Level 1 and Level 2 referral percentages reinforce a money-making structure tied to participation. The affiliate program also promises income for referring friends and family, even though the speaker advises viewers to research before investing.
